title: What You Get: Logo, Colour, Typeface, Image Style, Guideline | MonoBook
description: The five parts of a MonoBook identity, what each one is and where it is used.

blocks.lead: Five parts. Logo, colour, typeface, image style and one guideline.

blocks._whatItIsSource: live site descriptions, verbatim; 'van' swapped for [VEHICLE]

items.name: Logo
items.what: A primary and a secondary mark, with sizes and clear space rules. The same company shows up on a business card and on the side of a [VEHICLE].

items.name: Colour
items.what: One palette with exact values for print, screen, vehicle wrap and signage. Your sign maker and your web developer stop guessing.

items.name: Typeface
items.what: A licensed type system for headings, body and documents. Quotes and invoices start looking like they came from the same company.

items.name: Image style
items.what: A standard for job photos. Your own work becomes your proof.

items.name: Guideline
items.what: One document your printer, sign maker, web developer and team can work from without calling you first.

blocks.text: Tell us what you already have.
